## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated files.
- [ ] The code is clean and comments explain intent or risk.
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a repeatable test or documented manual check.
- [ ] Help text and dependencies are current.
- [ ] Destructive behaviour and elevated permissions are clearly disclosed.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or machine-specific paths are included.
